title: YOLOv3 diagnoses early gastric cancer on narrow-band endoscopy and assists endoscopists
summary: A YOLOv3 system was trained on 13 151 NBI images (810 patients) and tested on internal data, four external sets (1577 images, 147 patients) and 20 videos. AUCs were 0.888-0.951 and all cancers in the videos were diagnosed. Accuracy was 93.2%, above senior (85.9%) and junior (79.5%) endoscopists, and assistance raised them to 89.4% and 84.9%.
ai_technology: YOLOv3 object-detection model on narrow-band endoscopy images
organization: Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital; Nanjing University
